annotations.title: Home buyer report for an address

description: Everything a home buyer asks about one address, in one call: nearby primary, middle, secondary and private schools (England: Ofsted grades or report cards, pupils, faith, selective; US: grades, pupils per teacher, free lunch share, and the school district the address is in), how admissions and catchments work there, everyday places (supermarket, doctor, pharmacy, dentist, station, bus stop, park, playground, library, gym, cafe, pub, EV charger) with walk and drive minutes, a 15 minute walk check, the neighbourhood (US census tract income, home value, rent, owners, households with children, commute, against county and US; England deprivation deciles; England and Wales sale prices by property type for the postcode sector), flood zone (FEMA in the US, Environment Agency in England) and street crime for the latest month (England, Wales and Northern Ireland). Returns listing_lines, the raw data and sources. Takes 10 to 25 seconds.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).
